response: No, (18)F-FDG is not a direct surrogate tracer to measure tumor hypoxia. While (18)F-FDG uptake can be increased in hypoxic tumors due to increased glucose metabolism, it is primarily a marker of glucose metabolism and not a specific marker of hypoxia. Other tracers, such as (18)F-FMISO, (18)F-FAZA, and (64)Cu-ATSM, are more specific for imaging tumor hypoxia.
